## Checklist
- [ ] `bun run check` and `bun run build` pass in `site/`
- [ ] Page exists in French and English, with title and description
- [ ] `bun run test:a11y` passes (automated: axe WCAG 2.2 A/AA + skip link)
- [ ] Manual keyboard-only and screen reader pass on changed pages (automation finds ~30-40% of issues)
- [ ] No new cookie, tracker or third-party embed
